name: Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP), now under the Greater Bengaluru Authority

grievance.name: Greater Bengaluru Authority (BBMP) civic grievance channels
grievance.note: BBMP's Sahaaya websites failed TLS checks when tested on 18 Sep 2026. The 1533 civic helpline is widely cited for BBMP complaints; confirm the current channel on the GBA website.

rti.addressee: The Public Information Officer, Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike
rti.fee: The Karnataka RTI Rules prescribe a ₹10 application fee; applicants below the poverty line are exempt.
rti.note: Karnataka's RTI Online portal accepts applications and first appeals for Government of Karnataka public authorities only.
rti.requestRule: Karnataka Right to Information Rules, 2005, rule 14 (inserted in 2008): a request shall relate to one subject matter and shall not ordinarily exceed 150 words.
